hfpef-20-0.note: CKD-EPI2021 race-free creatinine equation; all four source categories <45/45–59/60–89/>=90 weighted by fixed HFpEF log HRs2.80/1.51/1.07/1 from Table3. Source postmenopausal women; local both sexes. No middle eGFR category is discarded.

rule.summary: eGFR-category risk index using the published equation, categories and fixed weights listed below.
rule.encoding:
female = c.Gender.eq('Female').to_numpy()
known = c.Gender.isin(['Female', 'Male']).to_numpy()
scr = c.creatinine.to_numpy()
age = c.age.to_numpy()
k = np.where(female, 0.7, 0.9)
alpha = np.where(female, -0.241, -0.302)
egfr = 142 * np.minimum(scr / k, 1) ** alpha * np.maximum(scr / k, 1) ** (-1.2) * 0.9938 ** age * np.where(female, 1.012, 1)
egfr[~known | ~np.isfinite(age) | (age < 18)] = np.nan
renal = np.select([egfr < 45, egfr < 60, egfr < 90], [np.log(2.8), np.log(1.51), np.log(1.07)], default=0.0)
egfr_index = np.where(np.isfinite(egfr), renal, np.nan)
rule.source_note: CKD-EPI2021 race-free creatinine equation; all four source categories <45/45–59/60–89/>=90 weighted by fixed HFpEF log HRs2.80/1.51/1.07/1 from Table3. Source postmenopausal women; local both sexes. No middle eGFR category is discarded.

egfr[~sexknown | ~np.isfinite(age) | (age < 18)] = np.nan

hba = c.hba1c.to_numpy()

hrs = np.select([ifcc < 43, ifcc < 48, ifcc < 53, ifcc < 63, ifcc < 73, ifcc < 83], [1.15, 1.0, 1.0, 0.93, 1.05, 1.14], default=1.52)
diabetes = hist('250.2')
score = np.where(np.isfinite(hba) & (diabetes > 0), np.log(hrs), np.nan)
hba1c_index = score

def hist(*codes):
    cols = [k for k in p if any((k == 'P_' + code or k.startswith('P_' + code + '.') for code in codes))]
    if not cols:
        raise ValueError('No supported diagnosis history ' + str(codes))
    return p[cols].max(axis=1).to_numpy(float)
rule.source_note: All seven IFCC categories <43,43–47,48–52,53–62,63–72,73–82,>82 mmol/mol: fixed published HR1.15/1/1/.93/1.05/1.14/1.52. Single latest pre-CT HbA1c, not source time-updated mean. Non-T2D or unmeasured accessions receive neutral Train imputation plus coverage flag.
